import sys, zipfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import radendur_track_render as r
z = zipfile.ZipFile('run/mame_roms/radendur.zip')
rend = r.Renderer(r.load_maincpu(z), r.load_gfx(z))
rom = bytearray(rend.rom)
e = r.TILE_TABLE
w, h, page, su, sv = 2, 1, 0, 198, 423
rom[e:e + 4] = (w - 1).to_bytes(2, 'big') + (h - 1).to_bytes(2, 'big')
rom[e + 12] = sv & 255
rom[e + 14] = su & 255
rom[e + 15] = (page << 2) | (1 if su & 256 else 0) | (2 if sv & 256 else 0)
rend.rom = bytes(rom)
nt, _, _ = rend.tile(0)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(nt.tobytes())
